title: UCI Online Retail — daily gross recorded sales
author: Daqing Chen (2015)
transformation: Daily sum across countries of positive quantities with positive sale price, excluding cancellation invoices. Days without qualifying recorded transactions are zero. No customer identifiers retained.
limitations: Historical gift retail, not fashion or current demand. Gross recorded sales, not net demand; returns excluded. Zero does not prove availability. Supplier lead time, MOQ, inventory at arrival and unit inventory cost are absent.
